verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Belvo sells separate products (aggregation, employment, payments, fiscal) and offers query filtering by link. Nothing documents product-scoped consent requests, per-scope permission selection, or data-minimization controls at consent time. Filtering list results by `link` is an adjacent pagination feature, not a consent scope.

support.subject: As a developer, I request only the data scopes I need — product-scoped consents and documented data-minimization controls, not an all-or-nothing grant
